The register-crosswalk staged a PNGRB citation for this exact cell (Capacity=78.25 MMSCMD, matching the register's 'Authorised/Design Capacity' of 78.3 MMSCMD) -- but that PNGRB figure is explicitly the authorised capacity for GITL's ENTIRE 1,881 km project (Phase I's 365 km operating + Phase II's 1,517 km under construction), not the actual capacity of the 365 km segment this 'Phase I' row describes. The deep-sweep audit shard for this row (batches/india-gas/staging/ref-sweep-operating/rows/P0938.json) independently found, via CARE Ratings' 2023 and 2025 press releases (curl+pdftotext-layout confirmed) and Business Standard's 15-Jul-2016 article on the actual RFCL Gas Transportation Agreement (verifier OK): 'the design capacity of phase-I is ~4.50 mmscmd [2025]/around 5 mmscmd [2023], of which ~2.02 mmscmd is supplied to RFCL under a GTA', and the 2016 GTA itself specifies GITL supplying '2 mmscmd of natural gas ... to RFCL's plant at Ramagundam'. Two organizationally distinct, more specific sources put this segment's actual capacity an order of magnitude below the recorded 78.25 MMSCMD. Per standing rule, I am not proposing a ref for the disputed 78.25 figure and am not proposing a replacement value myself (the audit shard notes ~4.5 vs ~5 vs the ~2.02-contracted figure are three different granularities of the same fact). Routing to Update: recommend changing Capacity to the Phase-I-scoped ~4.5-5 MMSCMD design figure, or adding a ResearcherNotes caveat if the field is deliberately meant to record the ultimate system-wide design capacity rather than this segment's built capacity.
